issues.legal_issue: An ad hoc succession fee is not a tribute extinguished by legislation that ends jagirdars’ liability to pay tribute.
material_facts: A successor to a jagir was required under the applicable land revenue law to pay a hukamnama fee when succession was recognized and the grant renewed.
The government demanded the fee after legislation had provided that jagirdars’ liability to pay tribute would cease.
The legislation defined tribute inclusively by reference to specified charges and charges of a similar nature; other provisions treated tribute as an amount payable for particular agricultural years.
The hukamnama was an ad hoc payment associated with recognition of succession, rather than a recurring annual payment.
issues.conclusion: The hukamnama liability was not included in the statutory meaning of tribute and was not extinguished; the demand could be enforced, and the petition was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: The meaning of an inclusive statutory definition must be determined in the context of the enactment as a whole, not solely by the ordinary dictionary meaning of the defined term. Under sections 2(r) and 4(a) of the Rajasthan Land Reforms and Resumption of Jagirs Act, 1952, read with section 8 and rule 4 of the Second Schedule and the relevant provision of the Third Schedule, tribute refers to recurring payments attributable to particular years, not ad hoc succession fees. Section 190 of the Marwar Land Revenue Act, 1949, provided for the hukamnama payment. The Court reached the same result as Thakur Narpat Singh v. State of Rajasthan, I.L.R. [1955] Rajasthan 534, on different reasoning.

predicates.constitutional_petition_challenges_fee_d: A person brings a constitutional petition challenging a government demand for a fee connected with succession to a jagir.
predicates.fee_is_ad_hoc: The demanded fee is a one-time charge connected with recognition of succession or renewal of a grant, rather than a recurring payment.
predicates.tribute_is_treated_as_yearly_in_the_stat: The enactment’s other provisions treat tribute as a recurring payment attributable to particular years.

issues.definition: When a constitutional petition challenges a succession-related fee demand, the fee is ad hoc, and the statutory scheme treats tribute as yearly, the ad hoc fee is not extinguished as tribute.
